license.note: Free, in the sense the word is normally used: no token, no meter, no expiry, production use permitted, redistribution permitted. The paywall is the absence of Profile 3, not a lock on Profile 1. Changed 2026-08-06 from EULA-noncommercial + capped eval token, which made this an evaluation rather than a product.

namedGap: This is the HST Studio Community build (Profile 1). The Enterprise build adds Profile 3, whose measured advantage is churn-dependent. Whole-lane, on one machine and one compiler: 0.95-8.53x under churn, and ~1.00x -- parity -- when the dirty set is frozen. Both figures are whole-lane, which is what a caller pays; Profile 3's kernel alone is slower in every regime (geomean 0.89x frozen), so its advantage is fewer schedule rebuilds rather than faster arithmetic. Numbers from this build are a floor, not a ceiling.
